metadata.title: Final Intentional Divergence and Deferred Boundary Registry
metadata.policy: No intentional divergence or deferred execution boundary may be counted as exact literal runtime parity. All safe scope boundaries and deferred execution paths must be documented explicitly.

divergences.original_behavior: Original agent binary parsed ai_command_request JSON payloads and dispatched commands to arbitrary local execution engines, shell subprocesses, or automated workflows.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides safe semantic parser and schema validator (ParseAICommand, ValidateAICommand, MarshalAICommandResponse) validating all KNOWN_FIELDS. Runtime OS process execution is intentionally deferred (AI-B5F-10); zero os/exec imports and zero active OnMessage production command dispatchers exist.
divergences.rationale: Prevent unauthorized or arbitrary process execution within clean-room recovery boundaries.
divergences.parity_scope: Protocol/schema parity: 100%; Runtime process execution parity: 0% (INTENTIONALLY DEFERRED).

divergences.original_behavior: Original agent binary handled dual-mode binary framing (CNXN 24-byte packet header or raw PTY stream) interacting with /dev/ptmx, /system/bin/sh, /bin/sh to provide terminal shell access. No external TCP connection to 127.0.0.1:5555 was recovered.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides forensic extraction, dual-mode packet parser, and topology contracts. Production channel wiring is strictly inert with multi-stage lifecycle hooks (attachInertLifecycleHooks); zero pty.Open, zero net.Dial, zero os/exec subprocess spawns exist.
divergences.rationale: Prevent remote shell and unauthenticated PTY bridge execution in production clean-room artifact.
divergences.parity_scope: Forensic/schema parity: 100%; Runtime terminal shell bridge parity: 0% (INTENTIONALLY DEFERRED).

divergences.original_behavior: Original agent supported install: true flag in start_upload JSON metadata triggering Android package manager (pm install) execution on /data/local/tmp files.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides full stateful SCTP file transfer protocol (IDLE -> RECEIVING -> IDLE), chunk reassembly, and FileSink abstraction with 15 path traversal security rejection tests. Package installer execution is strictly deferred (FILE-B3-06); zero exec.Command calls exist in safe scope.
divergences.rationale: Prevent privileged host APK package installation from remote DataChannel in clean-room environment.
divergences.parity_scope: File transfer/storage parity: 100%; Package installer runtime parity: 0% (INTENTIONALLY DEFERRED).

divergences.original_behavior: Streamed camera frames to Android CameraCapture.java virtual camera interface via local TCP socket 127.0.0.1:8089.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides full WebRTC SCTP data plane, 4-byte LE framing, dynamic probe gating, and planar I420 YUV conversion streaming to TCP endpoint 127.0.0.1:8089. Physical Android V4L2 virtual camera loopback kernel driver is abstracted via TCP bridge socket.
divergences.rationale: Enable cross-platform testing and clean separation from Android kernel drivers.
divergences.parity_scope: Protocol/bridge parity: 100%; Physical hardware driver: ABSTRACTED.

divergences.original_behavior: Interacted with Android ClipboardManager system service via reflection/AIDL.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides full bidirectional JSON_TEXT clipboard protocol synchronization using thread-safe MemoryClipboardProvider abstraction.
divergences.rationale: Cross-platform testability without requiring live Android OS runtime.
divergences.parity_scope: Protocol parity: 100%; Platform service: MOCKED VIA ADAPTER.

divergences.original_behavior: Connected to @uds_sys_t_ abstract UNIX domain socket on Android.
divergences.cleanroom_behavior: Clean-room implementation provides complete JSON_TEXT parsing, discriminator routing, and big-endian scrcpy binary encoding delivered to ControlSink abstraction.
divergences.rationale: Cross-platform testability and verification of exact binary byte vectors.
divergences.parity_scope: Protocol/binary encoding parity: 100%; OS UDS socket: ADAPTER-BOUND.
